maya: Weekly health check for NimbusAI — quick snapshot (usage, latency p95/p99 by route+model, streaming vs non-streaming, errors, spend). TL;DR: streaming reduces tail ~2x for generate/chat, embeddings showing a small error uptick and higher tail. Spend +12% MoM.

maya: Metrics (2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-16)
```
/generate (model: llama-2-13b)
  streaming: p95=210ms, p99=420ms
  non-stream: p95=420ms, p99=900ms
/chat (model: mistral-7b)
  streaming: p95=160ms, p99=330ms
  non-stream: p95=370ms, p99=820ms
/embeddings (model: embed-1x)
  non-stream only: p95=610ms, p99=1200ms
  error rate: 0.8% (baseline 0.2%)
Overall throughput: avg 85 TPS, peak 240 TPS
24h spend estimate: $12.3k (+12% MoM)
Active prod services: 9  | Onboarding: 2 in progress
Notes: streaming gives clear tail improvement for generate/chat. embeddings route shows timeouts on a subset of quantized hosts.
```

aj: Noted the embeddings errors — I pulled a couple sample logs. attaching excerpt: `embed-worker-3 -> 502 gateway at 03:14Z, retry 1/3, upstream timelimit`

sam: deploy-bot posted a related job yesterday — might be the quantize roll we did.
deploy-bot: quantize-job/nimbus-embeds completed (status: success) 2026-03-14T04:01Z

kevin: From quick glance this looks like noisy neighbor / IO saturation on q-hosts that serve embed-1x. Two options: pin embeddings to a dedicated pool (slower to provision) or enable async-batch fallback with client-facing 202 + background retry. Also recommend enabling KV cache for /generate routes to shave p99.

aj: I can pull host-level metrics (disk io, swap) and the request traces for the 502s. will also increase embed-worker log level for 24h.

maya: Action items:
  1) aj -> upload logs + host metrics to the ticket (owner: aj) :point_right: due EOD today
  2) kevin -> short routing proposal (pin vs async fallback) + rough cost delta (owner: kevin) :point_right: due tomorrow
  3) maya -> schedule enablement call with Nimbus (1hr) to review streaming adoption, cost controls, and per-route dashboard (owner: maya) :calendar: proposed Mon 10am PT
  4) cs note: renewal risk LOW but recommend call to surface enablement and per-route cost breakdown request from customer

aj: ack, uploading logs now. :thumbsup:

maya: Other feedback from customer: they'd like per-route cost breakdown in the Console and a brief runbook for embedding timeouts. capturing here for product/console ask.

kevin: I'll draft a short ops runbook for embed timeouts + rollback steps for quantize jobs.

maya: Thanks team — I'll post updates in this thread after logs + proposal. If we get a chance before the call, let's try the async-batch fallback for a small % to measure p99 impact.

sam: noted, will stand by for any quick experiments.

maya: end of check-in.
